title: ExplainReply
description: What a language model must answer when given an evidence pack. The engine rejects a reply that names a hypothesis or cites evidence that is not in the pack, or states a number the pack does not contain.

summary.description: The diagnosis in two or three plain sentences.

ranking.description: The pack's hypotheses in the order the writer would test them.

hypothesis.description: Key of a hypothesis in the pack.

cites.description: Ids of evidence in the pack.
